name: browser_act
description: Perform browser and desktop actions in the connected Runcove space, or check and cancel tasks created by its browser and screenshot tools.

oneOf.description: Click the referenced page element.

double.description: Double-click instead of a single click; default false.

ref.description: Element ref returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged.

oneOf.description: Replace the text of an editable page element.

ref.description: Editable element ref returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged.

submit.description: Press Enter after filling; default false.

text.description: Replacement text; an empty string clears the element.

oneOf.description: Select one option in a native HTML select element.

ref.description: Native select element ref returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged.

value.description: Exact option value or label. Value matches take precedence; the match must be unique.

oneOf.description: Set the checked state of a checkable page element.

ref.description: Checkable element ref returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged.

oneOf.description: Send a key or key combination to a page element.

key.description: Browser key or chord, such as "Enter" or "Control+a".

ref.description: Element ref returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged. When omitted, send keys to the selected page's focused element.

oneOf.description: Move the pointer over the referenced page element.

ref.description: Element ref returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged.

oneOf.description: Drag one page element to another.

ref.description: Source element ref returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged.

to_ref.description: Destination element ref returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged.

oneOf.description: Upload files from the connected Runcove space through a page's file input or file chooser.

paths.description: 1-20 absolute paths to readable regular files in the connected Runcove space, using the same filesystem as bash/read/write.

ref.description: Ref of a file input or an element that opens a file chooser, returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged.

oneOf.description: Click a page element to start a download, save the file in the Runcove space, and return its file information.

ref.description: Ref of the element that starts the download, returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged.

timeout_ms.description: Time limit in milliseconds for waiting for the download event and, separately, saving the download: 1000-60000; default 30000.

oneOf.description: Click a point in a returned page or desktop image.

double.description: Double-click instead of a single click; default false.

image_id.description: Image ID returned by browser_snapshot or screen_observe; copy unchanged. For a page image, the selected page must match the captured page.

x.description: Horizontal coordinate in the returned image's pixels, measured from the left edge: 0 <= x < image width.

y.description: Vertical coordinate in the returned image's pixels, measured from the top edge: 0 <= y < image height.

oneOf.description: Drag between two points in a returned page or desktop image. For page images, both endpoints must fit within one viewport.

image_id.description: Image ID returned by browser_snapshot or screen_observe; copy unchanged. For a page image, the selected page must match the captured page.

to_x.description: Destination horizontal coordinate in the same image's pixels: 0 <= to_x < image width.

to_y.description: Destination vertical coordinate in the same image's pixels: 0 <= to_y < image height.

x.description: Start horizontal coordinate in returned image pixels: 0 <= x < image width.

y.description: Start vertical coordinate in returned image pixels: 0 <= y < image height.

oneOf.description: Scroll an element into view, scroll to find text, or send vertical wheel input to the selected page.

dy.description: Vertical wheel distance per scroll in CSS pixels: -20000..20000; default 800. Positive values scroll down.

exact.description: For until_text only: require an exact text match; default false.

max.description: For until_text only: maximum number of scrolls, 1-30; default 15.

ref.description: Element ref returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged to scroll it into view. Excludes until_text, dy, exact and max.

until_text.description: Nonempty text to find by scrolling, checking the selected page and its iframes. Uses substring matching unless exact=true.

oneOf.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear in the selected page and its iframes, or pause for a fixed duration. Provide exactly one of text, gone or ms.

gone.description: Nonempty text to wait for until no visible matches remain.

ms.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds: 0-10000. Excludes timeout_ms.

text.description: Nonempty text to wait for until a visible match appears.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout for text or gone, in milliseconds: 100-30000; default 10000.

oneOf.description: Open a URL in the selected page.

url.description: Absolute URL using http, https, file, about or data. File URLs refer to the connected Runcove space's filesystem.

oneOf.description: Navigate through the selected page's browsing history.
Reload the selected page.
Create, close or focus a browser tab. Creating or focusing a tab selects it for subsequent page actions in this batch.

action.description: "new" creates a tab; "close" closes a tab; "focus" brings a tab to the foreground.

page_id.description: For close/focus only: tab ID from browser_snapshot's tabs[].page_id. Default: the currently selected tab.

url.description: For new only: initial absolute URL using http, https, file, about or data. Default: a blank page. File URLs refer to the connected Runcove space's filesystem.

oneOf.description: Set the policy for JS alert, confirm or prompt dialogs opened by later page steps in this batch. Place this step before the triggering action. Without a policy, dialogs are dismissed and reported. For an already-open native dialog, use a desktop image and desktop actions.

accept.description: true accepts subsequent dialogs; false dismisses them.

text.description: Text supplied when accepting a prompt dialog.

oneOf.description: Enter text into the currently focused control on the Runcove desktop, including native dialogs.

text.description: Text to enter; at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes.

oneOf.description: Send a key or key combination to the currently focused control on the Runcove desktop.

key.description: Desktop key or chord, such as "Return", "Escape" or "ctrl+l". Use 1-80 ASCII letters, digits, spaces or the characters _, + and -.

oneOf.description: Send wheel input at a position on the Runcove desktop.

delta.description: Wheel steps: -30..30; positive values scroll down.

image_id.description: Desktop image ID returned by screen_observe(view="desktop"); copy unchanged.

x.description: Horizontal position in the returned desktop image's pixels: 0 <= x < image width.

y.description: Vertical position in the returned desktop image's pixels: 0 <= y < image height.

oneOf.description: Change the state of the browser window containing the selected tab.

action.description: "execute" runs actions; "wait" retrieves task progress or results; "cancel" requests cancellation. Default "execute". For wait/cancel, provide task_id and optionally wait_secs; omit execution parameters.

action_timeout_ms.description: Execute only: timeout for element interactions, in milliseconds: 500-30000; default 5000. Navigation, explicit waits and downloads have separate limits.

actions.description: Required for execute: 1-20 ordered steps, each selected by do. Requires AI control; one modifying task runs at a time. The entire batch is validated before execution. Stops at the first runtime failure without undoing completed steps.

page_id.description: Execute only: initial tab for page actions, from browser_snapshot's tabs[].page_id. Default: the focused tab, or an available tab. Selecting it does not redirect desktop keyboard input.

task_id.description: Required for wait/cancel: task ID returned by browser_snapshot, browser_act, browser_read or screen_observe; copy unchanged.

then.description: Execute only: page feedback after execution. "diff" returns changes, "snapshot" returns a full snapshot, "none" omits page feedback. Default "diff". Failures retain completed results and available observations.

timeout_secs.description: Execute only: total task deadline in seconds, including preparation and all steps: 1-600; default 120.

wait_secs.description: Wait/cancel only: maximum seconds this call waits for task progress or completion: 0-30; default 30. Zero returns the current state immediately. Does not extend the task deadline.

name: browser_read
description: Read content from the selected browser page in the connected Runcove space, including its iframes: main text, element content, matching elements, tables, links or form fields.

extract.description: Extract tables ("table"), links ("links") or form fields ("fields") within ref, or across the page and its iframes. Default: plain text. Excludes query and max_chars. Results indicate truncation.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned for plain-text reading: 1-20000; default 4000.

page_id.description: Tab ID from browser_snapshot's tabs[].page_id. Omit or pass null to select the focused tab, falling back to an available tab.

query.description: Find observed elements whose name or text contains this string, case-insensitively, across the selected page and its iframes. Returns up to 20 matches. Excludes ref, extract and max_chars.

ref.description: Element ref returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged. Read its content or extract within its subtree. Default: main page content. Excludes query.

name: browser_snapshot
description: Inspect tabs and browser status in the connected Runcove space, and the selected page's interactive elements and floating panels, including those inside iframes. Returns element refs for browser_act and browser_read.

diff.description: Compare with this page's last unscoped snapshot or action feedback; default false. The baseline is shared across connections. A new document returns a full snapshot.

image.description: Include a full-page image annotated with element refs; default false. For unannotated images, timed sequences or saved PNGs, use screen_observe.

page_id.description: Tab ID from browser_snapshot's tabs[].page_id. Omit or pass null to select the focused tab, falling back to an available tab.

recent_tasks_limit.description: Number of recent browser and screenshot task summaries, newest first: 0-10; default 0.

ref.description: Element ref returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged. Scope the element list and optional text to its subtree. Default: whole page. Floating panels and images remain page-wide. Excludes diff=true.

text.description: Include up to 40 lines of page text within the selected scope; default false.

name: screen_observe
description: Capture full-page or desktop images in the connected Runcove space. Supports timed sequences and saving captured PNGs. Returns images with image_id values for coordinate actions. If a task_id is returned, retrieve the result with browser_act(action="wait").

count.description: Number of images to capture: 1-8; default 1.

interval_ms.description: Minimum interval between capture starts, in milliseconds, when count>1. Default 1000; zero captures back to back. Actual intervals may be longer. The entire observation must fit within 600 seconds.

page_id.description: For view="page": tab ID from browser_snapshot's tabs[].page_id. Default: the focused tab, or an available tab. Selected once for the sequence; closing it ends capture with an error. Ignored for view="desktop".

save_dir.description: Absolute directory in the connected Runcove space; requires save_original=true. Default /workspace/agent-space/artifacts. Uses the same filesystem as bash/read/write; creates missing directories and never overwrites files. Use a path under /workspace for downloadable files.

save_original.description: Also save captured PNGs before preview resizing or compression, and return their paths in files; default false.

view.description: Required: "page" captures the selected page's complete currently rendered document, including iframe regions as displayed; "desktop" captures the entire Runcove desktop, including native dialogs. Page capture does not load additional lazy content or expand independently scrolling iframe documents.
